# omni_model (Data Source)

Looks up a model by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The model's unique ID. One of `id` or `name` is required.
- `model_kind` (String) Restrict the lookup to a model kind, for example `SHARED`, `SHARED_EXTENSION`, `SCHEMA`, or `BRANCH`.
- `name` (String) The model name. One of `id` or `name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `base_model_id` (String) The model this one extends, if any.
- `connection_id` (String) The connection the model is built on.
